Definition: perhaps a primary word; a thigh:--thigh.
BiblicalUsage: Meros is the thigh, and Revelation 19:16 sets it in the last picture of the returning King: He hath on His vesture and on His thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name is written where a sword hangs, because the King who returns is the King who judges.
RelatedEvents: The Rider on the White Horse
